title: Irish monasteries preserve knowledge through the Dark Ages

tellings.quote: the Irish retreated into a series of monasteries and what they did was they dedicated themselves to preserving as much of the knowledge

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells how during the Dark Ages, roughly the 500s to 900s, the Irish retreated into a network of monasteries. According to Carlson, drawing on the book How the Irish Saved Civilization, they devoted themselves to preserving as much knowledge as they could, a story he uses to show how learning can survive a collapse.
